requirements.text: 4+ years (Engineer) / 6+ years (Sr. Engineer) / 8+ years (Staff Engineer) of experience building production software.
Strong full-stack capabilities, including backend services, APIs, databases, and (nice-to-have) frontend development.
A track record of shipping customer-facing products where reliability is critical.
An end-to-end ownership mindset, from requirements gathering through deployment and iteration.
Clear communication skills—you can explain technical decisions to diverse audiences.
Product thinking—you understand why you’re building something, not just how.

We work with a mix of TypeScript, Python, Node.js, React, cloud infrastructure, and workflow orchestration frameworks. You don’t need prior experience with our exact stack, but you should be comfortable learning new technologies quickly and applying them in production.

Designing systems for multi-tenancy, versioning, or complex authorization models.
A strong foundation in data modeling and distributed systems.
